name: SVC_ENGAGE_ENGMNT_METRICS
description: To hold metric information about an engagement between a customer and an automated agent.

columns.name: ENGAGEMENT_METRIC_ID
columns.description: Generated sequence for the primary key.

columns.name: SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the agent type that generated the metric.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the object that this metric was created for.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the object type of the object such as Service Request, SR Message, Chat, etc.

columns.name: USER_TURN_COUNT
columns.description: Number of times the user interacted with the automated agent.

columns.name: AGENT_RESOLUTION_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the resolution of the customer issue as generated by the automated agent.

columns.name: RESOLUTION_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the resolution of the customer issue.

columns.name: SUMMARY
columns.description: The summary of the customer issue.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SENTIMENT_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the sentiment of the customer issue.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_FEEDBACK_COMMENT
columns.description: The feedback from the customer for this engagement.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_FEEDBACK_RATING
columns.description: The feedback rating from the customer for this engagement.

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: The product associated with the customer issue.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: The category associated with the customer issue.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_FIRST_MESSAGE
columns.description: The initial question asked by the customer.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
